title: OpenLeverage2 — marginTrade Arbitrary DEX Data Injection Analysis
root_cause: The `marginTrade()` function executes DEX routing data (`dexData`) without validation, allowing the attacker to manipulate positions via crafted DEX data, then realize additional profit through a liquidation callback after price manipulation
steps: liquidate() call → additional profit via callback
other_code:
Attacker (Executor Contract)
  │
  ├─→ [TX 1]
  │   ├─ Create LP tokens + Create xOLE governance lock
  │   ├─ marginTrade(manipulated dexData) execution
  │   │   └─ Open price-manipulated position
  │   └─ liquidate() call → additional profit via callback
  │
  ├─→ [TX 2]
  │   ├─ payoffTrade() execution
  │   └─ Withdraw remaining profit
  │
  └─→ ~$234K drained
